name: repo-distillation-preflight
title_zh: 翻仓库先看许可证再谈蒸馏的合规审计员
tagline_zh: 想拿别人的代码做 Agent Skill？先让它扫一眼许可证、文档、测试和文件清单。
tagline_en: Turning a repo into a Skill? It checks license class, docs/tests/examples, and file inventory—so you don't get.
desc_en: Audit a local repository before turning it into an Agent Skill. Reports license class (permissive vs copyleft vs unknown), docs/tests/examples, and file inventory. Use when the user asks whether a repo is safe to distill or commercially reuse.
why_zh: 它把「能不能蒸馏」从拍脑袋变成清单式审计，专治那种 README 光鲜但许可证藏得深的 repo。
why_en: Turns 'can I distill this?' from a gut call into a checklist audit, catching repos with shiny READMEs but buried licenses.
limit_zh: 只审本地仓库，不联网查许可证全文或判例；对「未知许可证」只标记不裁决，商用前仍需律师确认。
limit_en: Local repos only; no online license lookup or legal rulings. Flags 'unknown' without judging—lawyer still needed for commercial use.
title_en: Repo license & content auditor before skill distillation
